disambiguation: It specifically checks components of identifiers (camelCase, snake_case, etc.), not general prose.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; currently supports US English only; does not support mobile.
intentEvidence: Obsidian normally treats a complete identifier as one spelling token. This plugin splits compound identifiers at case, underscore, and period boundaries
motivation: The first implementation attempted to reuse Chromium's native spellchecker for each component, but the query API was not connected to the useful spelling context used by the editor.
problem: Obsidian treats compound identifiers as a single spelling token, causing misspellings within identifiers to go undetected.
summary: A desktop-only plugin that checks words within camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and dotted identifiers independently, highlighting misspellings.
